description: Convert a CSV file or CSV string data to a JSON array.

columns.description: If true, treats the first line as column names and outputs an array of objects. Otherwise outputs an array of arrays. Defaults to true.

csvData.description: Raw CSV string data to parse.

delimiter.description: The field delimiter character. Defaults to ','.

filePath.description: Local filesystem path to the CSV file.

name: data_csv_to_json
